SPEC:

2. In the city card on the right, remove the "Camp" button; keep a single crimson "Travel" button and make the card a little shorter.
3. Directly to the LEFT of the city card add a square lacquer icon button "Quests" (scroll icon with a small gold "!" badge and the number 3), same copper-gold ring style as the bottom-right buttons, and show it OPENED: a slim popup list panel (same black-red lacquer with copper-gold double border, sakura corner, red tassel) unfolding to the left of the button, titled "Quests in Gharn", with three rows, each row a small diamond icon, a quest name and a short reward line: "Fed Tumen - 120 gold", "Goblin Alley - 80 gold", "The Orc Warlord - main quest". The popup must not cover the planet's city markers too much.
No other text changes.
Input images: Image 1: edit target — change only what is asked, keep everything else identical; Image 2: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
